title: Choose what endures beyond possession
summary: Possessions can fill the hand and still leave the soul empty. Choose the wealth Guru Nanak names: praise, truth, and Naam.
takeaway: Let the next desire prove itself against truth, not display.
lifeApplication: Before you buy, upgrade, or chase the next win, pause long enough to ask whether this choice adds truth to the heart or only weight to the mind.

source.shortMeaning: Possessions cannot cross the final threshold; praise, truth, and Naam can.
source.lifeApplication: At the point of desire, ask whether this choice strengthens truth or only feeds display.

evidence.coreClaim: Possessions cannot cross the final threshold; praise, truth, and Naam can.
evidence.turn: Guru Nanak turns purchase language into a test of what the soul can actually carry.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before you buy, upgrade, or chase the next win, ask whether this choice strengthens truth or only feeds display.
